items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Sometimes we made a thing with Bob Hope.

ctx.x: And when we'd go the studio we'd never know who was going to show up there. We were like what you would call the house band, one of them things. We would record with anybody that they had, you know. They would call Russell up, Russell would send so many of us to the gig, to the studio. Sometimes it would be Victoria. Sometimes it would be Wilton Crawley or somebody else. Anybody. We was recording with everybody.

Sometimes we made a thing with Bob Hope. Yeah, Bob Hope. I will never forget his theme song, you know, and we were playing his theme song. I mean, we were just like on the staff, you know, at that studio.
Who was the man at the studio who would call Russell? Do you remember that?
